scripts.translation:
[圣殿十字军]
恭喜。
向战士们致敬！

scripts.text:
[Paladin]
Do not forget
that the Holy War
is fast approaching!
We must ready ourselves!
May the light of justice
always brighten our path!
scripts.translation:
[圣殿十字军]
别忘了，圣战即将爆发！
我们必须做好准备！
愿正义之光
永远照亮我们的道路！

scripts.text:
[Paladin]
The Holy War will
be upon us before we
know it. More than ever,
we have need of strong men
and women to fight for what
is good and right.
scripts.translation:
[圣殿十字军]
圣战很快就会降临。
比以往任何时候，
我们都需要更多强大的男女，
为了正义而战。

scripts.text:
[Paladin]
Will you fight on
the side of righteousness
as a Paladin?
scripts.translation:
[圣殿十字军]
你愿意作为圣殿十字军，
站在正义的一方战斗吗？

scripts.text:
[Paladin]
When you're ready,
feel free to come back.
Honor to the warriors!
scripts.translation:
[圣殿十字军]
当你准备好的时候，
随时欢迎回来。
向战士们致敬！

scripts.text:
[Paladin]
It is still possible for you to learn more skills. Please use
all of your remaining Skill Points before returning to me.
scripts.translation:
[圣殿十字军]
你仍然可以学习更多技能。请在回来之前，
用完你剩余的所有技能点。

scripts.text:
[Paladin]
Congratulations.
As a Paladin, I hope
you will protect those
weaker than you, and bring
us victory in the upcoming
war between good and evil.
scripts.translation:
[圣殿十字军]
恭喜。
作为圣殿十字军，我希望你能保护比你弱小的人，
并在即将到来的正邪之战中为我们带来胜利。

scripts.text:
[Paladin]
Welcome
to Valhalla,
the Hall of Honor.
scripts.translation:
[圣殿十字军]
欢迎来到英灵殿，
荣誉之厅。

scripts.text:
[Paladin]
Please make
yourself comfortable
while you are here.
Honor to the warriors!
scripts.translation:
[圣殿十字军]
请在这里随意休息。
向战士们致敬！
